integrity: The directionwise brightness formula follows from a universal Fourier-amplitude computation and planar support-function area identity. The uniqueness of extremizing directions requires nonzero epsilon; at epsilon=0 all projections are disks. Finite symbolic checks are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Theorem concerns the canonical cubic family assuming its displayed support function is convex. For nonzero parameters, extrema are isolated as described; at zero every direction is extremal. No maximal admissible parameter range, classification of all exceptions, or brightness reconstruction/stability result is claimed here.
title: Exact brightness profile of the cubic threefold-projection exception
